body:
## Why

The coordinator needs memory to plan well across sessions. User memory holds standing preferences that carry to every trip, such as "we never eat at chains". Trip memory holds notes about this trip, such as why the user picked a lodge, so a later session doesn't ask again (technical spec 3.1). The `memory` MCP server gives the coordinator the four tools that read and write it. How memory is stored is already built: `MemoryWriter` and `MemoryReader` in `src/persistence/`.

These are among the first tools, so Joe reviews each server in its own PR: its description, its tools' descriptions, their input schemas, and what they return.

## Design

- [Technical spec](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/technical-spec.md), section 3.1.
- [Tool design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/tools.md), sections 1, 2.2, and 4.
- [Persistence design](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/design/persistence.md), section 8.8, for the memory classes the tools call.

## Open questions

- None.

## Do

- Make the `memory` MCP server. It holds all four memory tools.
- Make a new server for each session, built with that session's user and trip. No memory tool takes a user ID or trip ID as an input, so an agent can't reach another user's memory, even with a made-up ID (tool design, section 4).
- Follow the `trip` server's code (PR #44). `createTripServer()` in `src/tools/trip-server.ts` makes the server for one session from a `TripSession` (`src/tools/trip-session.ts`). The tools and their tests are in `src/tools/trip-brief-tools.ts` and `trip-brief-tools.test.ts`.

## Done when

- Tests with fake repositories (DEVELOPMENT.md section 5, such as `src/persistence/fake-memory-store.ts`) cover the four tools as tool design section 2.2 describes them. Examples: one user can't read, update, or forget another user's items through them, and the error is the same as for an ID that doesn't exist. An add over the maximum memory items or the maximum memory item length (technical spec section 10) is refused, and the error gives the limit.
- The PR shows the server's description, and each tool's description, input schema, and an example of what it returns. As in PR #44, take them from an MCP client connected to the real server object, so the schema is the JSON Schema the model sees.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** the PR. Propose each answer in the PR's decisions comment ([DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md), section 7), and Joe agrees by approving the PR.

---

Moved from phase 13b of the [development plan](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/plan/development-plan.md).
